title: Personalized Chatbot Trustworthiness Ratings
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus is on general trust issues like bias, abusive language, information leakage, and communication complexity.
models_tested: Chatbots from Ubuntu technical support corpus
Chatbots from Human Resource bot corpus
Chatbots from Restaurant reservation support corpus
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion.
